facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania's Cloud Computing Guidelines for Financial Service Providers, 2025 (issued under s.71 Banking and Financial Institutions Act 2006 and s.56(3) National Payment Systems Act 2015) bar a licensed financial service provider from hosting a mission-critical system, or one whose data the Bank deems critical, in a primary data centre or cloud whose hosting infrastructure is outside Tanzania; the document is dated August 2025.
